title: Autonomous Delivery Robot — 2022
summary: An early team-built delivery robot combining Raspberry Pi control, route planning and camera-based traffic-light recognition.
content:
Our team built an aluminium delivery robot controlled by a Raspberry Pi. The project won a regional Jugend forscht award in the Technology category.

Navigation and connectivity

The system combined camera-based recognition of red traffic lights, shortest-route planning using Dijkstra's algorithm and a simple lane-assistance function. Wi-Fi connected the robot with an app and database.

This entry describes the 2022 team project. The later 2023 work focused on more accurate self-localization through sensor fusion and is documented separately.
